name: Forellenhof
kurzbeschreibung:
**Welcome to Forellenhof in Tirol – your paradise for fresh trout and alpine charm!**

Nestled in the heart of the **Tiroler Alps**, our family-run **Forellenhof** invites you to savor the finest **Tiroler trout** in a cozy, rustic setting. Whether you're craving a crisp **Forelle Müllerin** or a hearty **Forellenragout**, our farm-fresh catch is prepared with love and served with a side of breathtaking mountain views.

**Experience Tirol like never before:**
- **Authentic cuisine:** From classic **Kaiserschmarrn** to **Tiroler Gröstl**, every dish is a taste of tradition.
- **Panoramic views:** Dine with a view of snow-capped peaks and lush valleys.
- **Local flavors:** Enjoy **Tiroler beer**, crisp **Apfelstrudel**, and homemade **Käsekrainer**—all made with regional ingredients.

Just a short drive from **Innsbruck**, our **Forellenhof** is the perfect stop for food lovers and nature enthusiasts alike. **Willkommen in Tirol!** Come taste the magic of the mountains.
